image_description: A vintage black typewriter viewed from a high angle. The image features a QWERTY keyboard with round, white-topped keys. The focal point is the elongated space bar at the bottom center of the keyboard, which is black and matches the body of the typewriter. The carriage return lever and platen are visible at the top.
